strategies.name: monolithic-milp
strategies.description: Build the full MILP in one pass and solve with a MILP solver. Right default for moderate scale with weak-to-moderate coupling.
actions: Write solve.py building the complete model with one MILP solver binding
Set a time limit; report result.json with status/objective/gap

strategies.name: decomposition
strategies.description: Split along the dominant coupling axis (e.g. Benders/Dantzig-Wolfe style decomposition) and iterate master/subproblem. Suited to high resource or temporal coupling where the monolith is intractable.
actions: Identify the complicating constraints from the profile's coupling dimensions
Write solve.py with a master/subproblem loop and convergence bound
Report best incumbent + bound in result.json

strategies.name: rolling-horizon
strategies.description: Decompose the time axis: solve overlapping windows sequentially, freezing the prefix. Suited to high temporal coupling at large scale.
actions: Choose window length and overlap from the horizon in scale_features
Write solve.py iterating windows, freezing past decisions
Report the concatenated schedule's objective in result.json

strategies.name: construction-plus-ls
strategies.description: Greedy construction heuristic followed by local search / large-neighborhood improvement. Fast and cheap; quality depends on problem structure.
actions: Write solve.py with a deterministic greedy construction
Apply local-search moves until a time or stagnation budget
Report the best solution found in result.json

strategies.name: cp-sat
strategies.description: Constraint-programming formulation solved with CP-SAT. Strong when route complexity is high and scheduling-like constraints dominate.
actions: Write solve.py modeling with interval/circuit constraints
Solve with CP-SAT under a time limit; report result.json

strategies.name: lp-relaxation-rounding
strategies.description: Solve the LP relaxation, then repair/round to an integer-feasible solution. Very cheap; use as warm-start evidence or when approximate answers suffice.
actions: Write solve.py solving the LP relaxation
Apply a deterministic rounding/repair pass
Report the rounded objective and the LP bound in result.json

strategies.name: warm-start-milp
strategies.description: Construct a heuristic incumbent first, then hand it to the MILP solver as a warm start. Pays off when construction is reliable and the monolith is borderline tractable.
actions: Write solve.py: greedy construction -> MIP start -> time-limited solve
Report incumbent and bound in result.json

strategies.name: column-generation
strategies.description: Delayed column generation for set-covering/partitioning-style structure (routes, patterns, shifts). Suited to high route complexity with strong resource coupling.
actions: Write solve.py with restricted master + pricing subproblem loop
Close with a final restricted-integer solve if time permits
Report incumbent + LP bound in result.json

strategies.name: lagrangian-relaxation
strategies.description: Relax the complicating (resource-coupling) constraints into the objective with multipliers; subgradient/bundle updates. Good bounds for highly resource-coupled problems.
actions: Write solve.py with multiplier update loop and primal repair heuristic
Report best primal objective and dual bound in result.json

strategies.name: metaheuristic-ga
strategies.description: Population-based metaheuristic (genetic/local hybrid). Last-resort broad search when structure resists decomposition and CP-SAT.
actions: Write solve.py with encoding, fitness, crossover/mutation, and a time budget
Report the best solution found in result.json
